Document type: adjuster_file. Page 1 of 2.

<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1215
Claimant:
Paul Wells
Adjuster:
Jerry Hanson
1-23-24
Claim received for a sideswipe that occurred while the insured was changing lanes on a multi-lane road. The claimant
is reprseented by counsel, and the file has been opened for bodily injury and property damage.
2-20-24
Reviewed the policy record and confirmed the driver involved is named on the policy and the coverage was in force at
the time of the loss.
2-26-24
Police report obtained. It places the claimant in the vehicle at the scene and records the lane-change sideswipe as
described in the first notice of loss.
4-21-24
Statements taken from two independent witnesses and the other driver. All three describe the collision the same way,
and photos from the scene are consistent with that account.
5-3-24
Inspected the vehicle damage. The location and pattern of the damage match the described impact, and there is no
sign of earlier damage to the vehicle in the records or on inspection.
5-14-24
Claimant's counsel provided the medical file. The reported neck and back strain fits the kind and force of the crash,
and no prior treatment to the same body area appears in the records.
6-17-24
Follow-up interview with the claimant. Some small details were added to the account, but the core description of the
collision has not changed from the first statement.
6-29-24
Treatment followed a typical course and tapered as the claimant improved. Provider notes show steady progress with
no unusual gaps or escalation.
7-4-24
Nothing in the file suggests the damage predates the policy start. Recommend proceeding with evaluation of the
bodily injury and property damage claims under standard handling.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
